title: Different Types of Secondary Battery and their application
description: Different Types of Secondary Battery and their application What is a Secondary Battery? In Common words, Secondary Battery is known as Rechargeable Battery.

sections.heading: Different Types of Secondary Battery and their application
paragraphs: What is a Secondary Battery? In Common words, Secondary Battery is known as Rechargeable Battery. Secondary batteries are batteries with electrochemical cells whose chemical reactions can be reversed by applying a voltage to the battery in the reversed direction. any query related battery testing as per IS/IEC standards visit our website www.itcindia.org or email us on info@itcindia.org

headers: Types of Secondary Battery: There are basically four Types of Secondary Battery. Which are the following:
rows: l Nickel Cadmium (Ni-Cd) (Testing as per IEC 61951-1) l Nickel-Metal Hydride(Ni-MH) (Testing as per IEC 61951-2) l Lead-Acid ( Testing as per IS 1651, IEC60896-11) l Lithium-ion(Li-ion) (Testing as per IS 16046, IEC 62133)
For any query visit our Website www.itcindia.org or Email us on info@itcindia.org

sections.heading: Pictures of Nickel Cadmium (Ni-Cd) battery
paragraphs: Application: The small packs are used in portable devices, electronics and toys while the bigger used in aircraft, Electric vehicles.

sections.heading: Pictures of Nickel Cadmium Nickel-Metal Hydride (Ni-MH) battery
paragraphs: Pictures of Nickel Cadmium Nickel-Metal Hydride (Ni-MH) battery
Application: Ni-MH cells are often used in digital cameras and other high-drain devices.

sections.heading: Pictures of Lead-Acid Battery
paragraphs: Application: Lead acid batteries are a low-cost reliable power workhorse used in heavy duty applications. They are usually very large and because of their weight, they’re always used in non-portable applications.
